writeup: Woot has the YPLUS 12-piece geometry set (model 305101) for $6.99. The kit comes in a metal case and includes a protractor, compass, rulers, and a 0.5mm mechanical pencil, matching the brand's 12pc student set. YPLUS's own site lists that same 12-piece model at $15.99, and TrueDesk has it at $34.99, so this is about 56 percent below the brand's price and saves about $9. Quantity is capped, with at least one left and a limit of one per customer.
